run_reconstruction_evaluation: run the reconstruction evaluation script on a Poincaré embeddings checkpoint file to compute mean rank and mAP
run_reconstruction_with_sample: run the reconstruction evaluation on a random sample of nodes from the checkpoint dataset
run_reconstruction_quiet: run the reconstruction evaluation in quiet mode without progress output
run_reconstruction_multi_worker: run the reconstruction evaluation with multiple workers for parallel processing
review_reconstruction_workflow: review the reconstruction evaluation workflow that loads a checkpoint, builds adjacency, and evaluates embedding quality
